type._: The paper's grid: characters per line, the print head's step per character, the platen's turn per line (as paper travel), and the roll's width.

geometry._: Owned by teleprinter.py: rewritten from the model whenever it changes (blender/build.sh). Metres in Blender frame (Z up, machine faces -Y, reader right = +X); [y, z] pairs lie in the plane x = 0. The head rests at column 0 and slides +X one pitch per character; the platen turns about its local X, positive = line feed (paper moves up at the front).
